fluff.overview: The Free Worlds League's fractious politics have always made centralized BattleMech procurement difficult, pushing the FWLM toward heavy investment in conventional infantry to fill the gaps. Foot infantry platoons form the garrison backbone of the League's provincial militaries, assigned to hold ground on worlds that BattleMech forces cannot permanently occupy. Quality varies with provincial investment, but even modest foot platoons benefit from the FWLM's tradition of equipping infantry with reliable, standardized kit. Carrying infantry-scale gauss rifles that use magnetic acceleration to propel projectiles at extreme velocities, these platoons field the longest-ranged and hardest-hitting personal ballistic weapon available to conventional soldiers.
